## Simulation and visualization of different distributions

### Gamma distribution

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function gammaFn(z) {
  const g = 7;
  const p = [0.99999999999980993, 676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028,
    771.32342877765313, -176.61502916214059, 12.507343278686905,
    -0.13857109526572012, 9.9843695780195716e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];
  if (z < 0.5) {
    return Math.PI / (Math.sin(Math.PI * z) * gammaFn(1 - z));
  }
  z -= 1;
  let x = p[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < g + 2; i++) x += p[i] / (z + i);
  const t = z + g + 0.5;
  return Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI) * Math.pow(t, z + 0.5) * Math.exp(-t) * x;
}

function gammaPDF(x, shape, scale) {
  if (x <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.pow(x, shape - 1) * Math.exp(-x / scale) /
    (gammaFn(shape) * Math.pow(scale, shape));
}

function randomNormal() {
  let u = 0, v = 0;
  while (u === 0) u = Math.random();
  while (v === 0) v = Math.random();
  return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
}

function sampleGamma(shape, scale) {
  if (shape < 1) {
    const u = Math.random();
    return sampleGamma(shape + 1, scale) * Math.pow(u, 1 / shape);
  }
  const d = shape - 1 / 3;
  const c = 1 / Math.sqrt(9 * d);
  while (true) {
    let x, v;
    do {
      x = randomNormal();
      v = 1 + c * x;
    } while (v <= 0);
    v = v * v * v;
    const u = Math.random();
    if (u < 1 - 0.0331 * x * x * x * x) return d * v * scale;
    if (Math.log(u) < 0.5 * x * x + d * (1 - v + Math.log(v))) return d * v * scale;
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof shape = Inputs.range([0.1, 20], {value: 2, step: 0.1, label: "Shape"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof scale = Inputs.range([0.1, 10], {value: 2, step: 0.1, label: "Scale"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof resample = Inputs.button("Generate new draw")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
draws = {
  resample;
  return Array.from({length: 1000}, () => sampleGamma(shape, scale));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
histogram = {
  const xmax = d3.max(draws) * 1.05;
  const bin = d3.bin().domain([0, xmax]).thresholds(30);
  const bins = bin(draws);
  const n = draws.length;
  return bins.map(b => ({
    x1: b.x0,
    x2: b.x1,
    density: b.length / (n * (b.x1 - b.x0))
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pdfPoints = {
  const xmax = d3.max(draws) * 1.05;
  const xs = d3.range(0, xmax, xmax / 300);
  return xs.map(x => ({x, y: gammaPDF(x, shape, scale)}));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {Plot} from "@observablehq/plot"

Plot.plot({
  width: 640,
  height: 360,
  marginLeft: 50,
  title: `Gamma: shape = ${shape}, scale = ${scale}`,
  x: {label: "x"},
  y: {label: "Density"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect(histogram, {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: 0, y2: "density", fill: "#BCD4E6"}),
    Plot.line(pdfPoints, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "#C0392B", strokeWidth: 2})
  ]
})
```
